limitations: Original run.json, archived INI files and native-preflight proof were not supplied. Reconstructed declarations check compatibility, not original run provenance.
Recorded starts, identities, opening prefixes, search settings and outcomes match the declarations. Engine names and profile hashes do not attest the executable or native material tables.
Moves and terminal outcomes were not independently replayed. No games, engine searches, material fit, Elo or population confidence interval were produced.

provenance.policy: Preserve the prior applied baseline for movement revisions and the three-step orthogonal grant. New three-point king-step and knight grants use their custom-piece automatic raw MG/EG values. Apply each declared pair to all six engine tables, preserving all four official reference pairs. No values are fitted from outcomes.

baseline.policy: Current-design automatic raw MG/EG values, applied consistently to all six engine tables for every sibling. Shared diagonal grants use F as their common anchor. Existing references remain fixed. No values are fitted from game outcomes.

provenance.diagnostic: levelupvalues version 1; no searches or match games

overall.method: Equal opponent means over shared fully completed opening cases; every configured repetition requires a complete color pair. Draws count half a point.
